evals.prompt: Use github-issue-workflow to inspect example-org/plain#52 and give a read-only intake plan. The repository uses human assignees and linked active PRs, no managed queue, and default branch trunk. The issue is open with no assignees. CI=1, but there is no explicit dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Gather remaining read-only ownership and repository evidence without requiring a particular control plane or claiming anything.
assertions: Uses the repository's configured ownership process
Does not infer a worker dispatch from CI
Does not mutate during read-only intake

evals.prompt: Use github-issue-workflow to inspect example-org/widget#41. Repository guidance names an installed operator skill for its managed work queue. That authority reports another active fleet run owns the issue. The issue has no GitHub assignees. Plan only.
evals.expected_output: Consult the configured operator guidance and respect the active owner despite an empty assignee field.
assertions: Does not treat missing GitHub assignees as free

evals.prompt: Use github-issue-workflow to prepare a PR for example-org/widget#53 after three hours of work. A parallel implementation has merged. Explain the required next checks and handling without pushing or creating a PR.
evals.expected_output: Check current issue/base/PR state, avoid a duplicate implementation, and isolate any salvageable deltas.
assertions: Does not mechanically resolve a duplicate implementation
Preserves salvageable deltas as focused follow-up work
Uses closing syntax only for fully completed acceptance
